_readme.cfgVersionExplained: cfgVersion format = YYMMDD-NN (settings snapshot date + increment). '260720-89' = the 89th settings build stamped 2026-07-20. It tracks the DATA/settings snapshot; the app code version is the separate 'v21.38' in the header. They move independently: editing settings bumps cfg; new features bump the app version.
designPrinciples: Our design principles (internal notes for how we build this):

1) SEPARATE DATA FROM CODE. All our specifics (people, equipment, routes, rates, passes, estimates) live in ONE editable config object exported as a single JSON = our portable source of truth. The HTML stays generic; the JSON carries the data.

2) MODEL DIMENSIONS INDEPENDENTLY, DON'T HARDCODE. Route, truck, driver, helper, day, and base/site permit are each their own list with per-day overrides (start times, bases, helper-needed, estimates). Adding a route or a rule never means touching logic.

3) DEFAULTS + REASONED EXCEPTIONS. Everything usual is pre-filled (usual routes, usual bases, projected hours); any deviation is allowed but REQUIRES a logged reason — captures the why for audit without slowing the normal case.

4) VALIDATE, DON'T BLOCK BLINDLY. Three tiers — hard errors that block posting (missing driver, expired required permit, same-time double-book), soft warnings to confirm (unusual day, 2+ shifts), and routine checklist items. Guardrails, not handcuffs.

5) OUTPUT IS A VIEW OF THE DATA. The WhatsApp/Kakao drafts are generated from the same model, gated behind an explicit Generate so a draft is never silently stale. Crew vs office = two renderers off one source.

6) PROJECT FORWARD, RECONCILE WITH ACTUALS. Hours/cost start as estimates and are overwritten by real numbers as they arrive (manual now, timesheet-automation later). The 40h OT threshold + cost fall out of the same running model.

7) NON-CODER-EDITABLE + OFFLINE. Every setting is editable in-app; sandbox-safe custom dialogs (no native alert/confirm); persists in localStorage; optional static hosting (GitHub Pages) with fetch-latest so one URL serves everyone — no backend, no login.

8) PLAN THESE INPUTS EARLY (hardest to backfill): per-person/route/day familiarity + guide rules; per-person availability constraints; real duration + speed per route/day; permit/credential expiries; pay rates incl. multi-employer OT.

versionLog.note: Root cause of the duplicate-route edit bug: the data-editextra click wiring ran BEFORE the table was inserted into the DOM (host.querySelectorAll matched nothing), so the extra edit links never bound — moved the wiring to AFTER host.appendChild(tbl). type=number inputs were swallowing select/backspace/delete in the sandbox browser; text + inputmode=decimal + a parseFloat/NaN guard is the reliable pattern. Guide/trainee role rendered via .cdd-name (ellipsis) + small .cdd-role tag so the Helper field height never grows.

The Lagu-first toggle was always global (single top-level LAGU_FIRST var) so it already flowed between views; the confusion was that its ONLY visible output (the reg/OT cost split) shows in Worker view, so it is now hidden in Route view rather than duplicated. If we later surface OT cost in Route view, re-show the checkbox there.

versionLog.feat: (1) WORKER VIEW hour entry: the projected estimate is now PREFILLED as real editable text in the cell (select-all on open) so it can be selected, backspaced, deleted, or retyped — no more un-editable placeholder guide text. A dirty-flag means simply opening a cell and clicking away will NOT convert the projection into a saved actual; only an actual edit does (clear the field to revert to the projection). (2) NEW CHECK DH1: flags as an ERROR if the SAME person is assigned as both the driver and the helper on one route/day (previously slipped through because driver and helper double-book checks ran on separate name-lists). (3) ROUTE VIEW helper badge: added a fallback so a route/day missing from helperNeededByRouteDay still shows yellow 'Helper needed' / grey 'No helper needed' (inferred from the route's needsHelper) instead of a bare dash — applied to the primary row, every secondary/duplicate row, AND empty running cells. (4) ROUTE VIEW extra-assignment editor: removed the redundant '✓ done' button — it now closes on an outside click exactly like the primary cell editor (sets data-editing so the global outside-click handler catches it); the '✕ remove' button stays. (5) 'Clear typed-in hours' button is now hidden in Route view (typed-in hours only exist in Worker view).
versionLog.note: Empirically simulated the badge lookup against the real helperNeededByRouteDay before touching code: defined route/days rendered correctly for both primary and secondary (they share ar/rn/dow3, so there was never a primary-vs-secondary asymmetry) — the ONLY gap was undefined route/days returning a bare em-dash, so the fallback closes that. Worker input: reverted from the placeholder-only pattern to index31's prefilled-editable-text approach but guarded with a dirty flag so auto-focus+select on open can't create a spurious override. DH1 was invisible before because bookingConflicts() classifies drivers and helpers in separate maps, so one name in each never collided. Considered a Route-view 'Clear assignments' button in place of the hidden hours button but left it out — wiping a week's plan is destructive and Reset Day (per-day, on Generate) already covers it; can add a confirm-gated version on request.

versionLog.feat: (1) NO-DRIVER checklist de-duplication: a route with a helper (or truck) but no driver used to raise BOTH D00 ('truck/helper assigned but NO driver') and D08 ('helper but no driver') — now exactly ONE fires per row: D08 (the specific helper-only-not-allowed message) when a helper is present, otherwise D00 ('truck assigned but no driver') when only a truck is present, otherwise the soft 'no driver chosen yet' warning. (2) Cross-route CONFLICT items (driver/helper/truck double-booked or on 2+ shifts) are no longer filed under a bare weekday like '[Thu]' — they now read '[Thu · Conflicts]' so the Resolve group is clearly a schedule-wide people/equipment clash, not an orphan route. (3) WEEK VIEW route-cell EDIT-LINK CONSISTENCY: in a multi-assignment cell, the PRIMARY row now shows a visible 'edit' link to match each secondary row, and every secondary row now also shows its own 'Xh route' duration estimate (previously only the primary did). versionLog.note: D00/D08 overlapped because D08 ran as a standalone check right after the D00 else-if; folded D08 into the no-driver branch with precedence order helper->truck->none so only one message emits. Conflict loops passed bl.dow3 as the location key, which the checklist renders as a bare '[Thu]' group with no route; appending ' · Conflicts' labels it without pretending it belongs to a single route (double-booking is inherently cross-route). The primary edit link carries no data-editextra and no stopPropagation, so a click simply bubbles to the existing td[data-cell] handler and opens the primary editor — no extra wiring, and the secondary data-editextra links keep their own handlers. Chose to ADD duration to the secondary rather than REMOVE it from the primary, so consistency was achieved without losing the estimate anywhere (better than the user's worst-case 'even if duration is less visible').

(2) DRIVERS/HELPERS tab: removed the redundant OUT chip next to the until-date (the row already tints amber) and narrowed the 'Out (from → until)' column. (3) TRAINEE picker: the 'All front-loader' / 'All routes' quick-add buttons now sit on the SAME line as Driver/Route/Days/Add. (4) LOAD USUAL ROUTES now drops carried EMPTY rows that aren't usual for the new weekday (e.g. Central/Southern left over after Tue→Wed) — reproducing the old Reset-then-Load result WITHOUT deleting a deliberately-filled rollover (which is kept and still warns).
versionLog.note: drv/hlp in assignmentRow switched from availDrivers()/availHelpers() to the full CFG lists with an onLeave() '(OUT)' tag; autoFillOff/suggestOff/validate still call availDrivers()/availHelpers() so OFF math is unchanged. Load-Usual prune filters bl.assignments to keep a row only if its route is usual OR it has any driver/helper/truck, run right after names is computed and after normalizeDayRoutes(); genuine filled rollovers survive.

versionLog.feat: (1) FIX: switching the date away and back (e.g. Tue→Wed→Tue) no longer drops Central to the bottom of the Daily View — routes are now re-sorted N→Yard AFTER the week-plan is pulled back in (the pull was re-appending carried routes past the earlier sort). (2) On-leave workers in the Daily View HELPER dropdown now show a real amber 'OUT' pill on a tinted row (instead of a plain '(OUT)'). (3) On-leave DRIVER options are tinted amber (native <select> can't render a pill, so the row is highlighted and still labelled OUT). The Drivers/Helpers-tab amber row tint is unchanged.
versionLog.note: Root cause of the Central-at-bottom bug: ensureDay() runs migrateDay() (which sorts) THEN pullWeekIntoDay(), and the pull pushes any WEEK.plans route not already present onto the end — so a re-added Central landed last; added sortDayRoutes() immediately after the pull. Helper dropdown is a custom .cdd list so it takes a styled .pill; the driver dropdown is a native <select> whose <option>s can only take background-color/color (Chrome), so OUT there is a tint, not a pill.

versionLog.feat: (1) The Daily View DRIVER field is now the same custom list widget as the Helper field, so an on-leave driver shows a real amber OUT pill on a tinted row in the dropdown (matching the helper look) rather than a plain tint. (2) TAB-ORDER FIX on the Drivers/Helpers tabs: editing an Out-from/Out-until date no longer rebuilds the whole table on each change, so focus is kept and Tab moves correctly from-→until→reason (the row tint updates in place). Editing outFrom no longer forces a re-render at all.
versionLog.note: Driver widget mirrors the helper .cdd (data-d marker); its click handler allows selection only when the row isn't locked by ANOTHER row (self-locked row stays editable so a bad base-pass driver can be swapped), and the lock-grey pass now skips the driver widget on a self-locked row. Root cause of the 'Tab jumps to the left field' report: the outFrom/outUntil change handlers called renderDrivers()/renderHelpers(), which recreates every input, so the browser lost the focused element and the next Tab restarted from the row's first input; fixed by committing the value without a full re-render and updating tr.style.background inline.

versionLog.feat: The Daily View DRIVER field now shows BLANK when no driver is chosen (matching the empty Truck dropdown), instead of the grey '— pick —' placeholder.
versionLog.note: Only the empty-state label of the driver .cdd widget changed (cdd-name span left empty); an on-leave selected driver still shows the amber OUT pill, and the panel's first option is still the explicit '— none —' to clear a pick.

versionLog.feat: LEAVE dates (Out from / Out until) on the Drivers & Helpers tabs now accept BOTH manual yymmdd typing AND a calendar picker: each date has a small 📅 button that opens the native date picker and writes the chosen date back into the field in yymmdd. Storage stays yymmdd, so the onLeave() range logic and everything else is unchanged. The date-picker helpers and calendar buttons are removed from the Tab sequence, so Tab still flows name → from → until → reason.
versionLog.note: Kept yymmdd as the stored format (most resilient — no migration, no change to onLeave/isOut string compares). Each Out cell is a .calwrap containing the yymmdd text input + a hidden native <input type=date> + a 📅 button; the button seeds the date input from the current yymmdd, calls showPicker(), and on change converts YYYY-MM-DD back to yymmdd and dispatches the text input's change event so the normal save path runs. Driver/Helper row wiring was converted from positional ins[] indices to CLASS selectors (.dn/.hn/.ofd/.oud/.rsn/.cdr/.knw/button.del) so the added date inputs don't shift indices; the hidden date inputs and 📅 buttons are tabindex=-1 to preserve the fixed tab order.

versionLog.feat: (1) LEAVE from/until are now native date fields (like the Daily View service-date box) — the calendar icon sits INSIDE each field, opens on click, and a manually keyed date shows as selected in the picker. Storage stays yymmdd (converted on read/write), so onLeave() is unchanged. Replaces the separate 📅 button that would not open on the Drivers tab. (2) The Daily View DRIVER dropdown first option is now a blank clickable row (to clear) instead of '— none —'. Out columns widened to fit the two date fields.
versionLog.note: outCellHtml emits <input type=date> with value converted yymmdd->YYYY-MM-DD; wireOutCell converts back on change. Removed the hidden-date+calbtn approach whose showPicker sometimes no-opped on the Drivers tab. Native date inputs are keyboard AND calendar editable and auto-populate the picker from a typed value. Driver clear-row uses  +min-height so it stays clickable while blank, matching the Truck select empty option.

versionLog.feat: (1) A no-truck route with nobody assigned (e.g. an empty Yard row left on the day) is no longer printed in the WhatsApp or Kakao draft — empty no-truck rows are filtered before the time header, so no orphaned blank YARD: line. A Yard row with a helper still prints. (2) NO WHACK-A-MOLE: a blank running route (e.g. Roll-Off left empty) now flags BOTH the missing truck AND the missing driver as ERRORS in Resolve at once (the empty-row branch's soft WARN became an ERROR 'a driver is required').
versionLog.note: Applied onto v21.59 (v21.60 upload was a stub). Draft: added .filter(a=>routeSpecOf(a).noTruck?(a.driver||a.helper):true) to the per-start slots in BOTH renderWA and renderKK, before if(!slots.length)return so the time header is skipped when the only row was an empty Yard. Validation: WARN D00 -> ERROR D00 so T00+D00 land together.

versionLog.feat: (1) WORKER VIEW: the Total cell now shows a compact affiliate line ('+X aff → ΣY') under the billed total whenever a worker has affiliate hours, so the combined figure that TRIGGERS overtime is visible (billed cost is still Lagu-only). (2) DAILY DRAFTS: multiple no-truck workers (e.g. several Yard helpers) at the SAME start time now print as a single comma-separated list ('Yard: Ron, Davis, Joseph') in both WhatsApp and Kakao, instead of one line each. Different start times stay on separate lines.
versionLog.note: Affiliate line uses affiliateHrs(nm) + lc.combined (already computed by laborCostChrono); shown only when >0 so normal rows are unchanged. Comma-merge groups no-truck rows by waLabel (WA) / routeLabelOf (KK) within each start slot; truck routes are untouched. Empty no-truck rows were already dropped by the v21.60 filter, so only staffed Yard names merge.

versionLog.feat: (1) CONSISTENCY: the leftover '— none —' placeholders are now uniformly BLANK on empty dropdowns — the Action and VCC selects and the Helper field's no-need fallback — matching the already-blank Subject/Target/Timing/Base/Truck/Driver controls. (2) The Yard row's non-applicable Truck and Driver now read 'None' (capitalized) instead of '— none —'. (3) DATA: Monday route-hour estimates changed — Northern 12→9h, Southern 12→11h (cfg 260729-92→260729-93).
versionLog.note: Blank vs None: dropdown EMPTY OPTIONS are blank (nothing chosen yet); the Yard truck/driver are a fixed NOT-APPLICABLE state, so a word reads clearer than a blank — 'None' capitalized matches the checklist's existing 'None' (no errors/warnings). Consistency flag: the base-pass badge still uses lowercase 'none' and the week grid uses 'N/A' for non-running routes — those are left as-is (different contexts), so 'None' is consistent with the checklist convention but the app does carry three none/N-A forms across contexts. Est change edits defaultConfig only; a browser with saved settings must Reset the day, Import the new JSON, or edit the Route Hour Estimates tab to pick it up.
